review_candidates.title: Cost Controller

AtkinsRéalis is hiring a Cost Controller to join our team. The Cost Controller reports to the Senior Manager, Project Cost Control. This position s based in our Toronto, Ontario offices. Your role Maintain cost control and cost management processes for infrastructure construction project. Monitor project performance by tracking actual costs, commitments, productivity, and progress against approved budgets. Prepare cost reports, variance analysis, earned value analysis, forecast updates, cost projections, and performance dashboards for project. Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Discipline Leads to develop accurate forecasts/estimate at completion. Evaluate, track, and manage change orders, scope changes, and claims, assessing their impact on project budgets, schedules, and overall project performance. Support project controls activities to ensure effective cost and schedule impact timely captured throughout the project lifecycle. Provide project controls insights to Construction/Contract Management teams to support contract administration, and contractor performance evaluations. Participate in project meetings and reviews, cost performance updates to support informed decision-making. Contribute to project risk assessments by identifying potential cost exposures to support successful project delivery. About You Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Engineering, Construction Management, Civil Engineering Technologist (Construction Management Major SAIT/NAIT) or a related discipline / combination of education and experience 5+ years of experience in Cost Control, Project Controls, ideally supporting infrastructure, transit, transportation, utilities, or major capital construction projects. Demonstrated experience in delivery of construction projects, understanding of complex construction contracts, change management, contractor performance evaluation, progress payments, and project controls integrated reporting. Proficiency with Advanced Excel and project controls/reporting tools such as Primavera P6, and Power BI. Strong understanding of project controls principles, cost management, budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, and risk management. Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, reporting, and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary project environment while managing multiple priorities and stakeholders. Rewards & benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada. Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs. Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life. Be rewarded. Find out more. About AtkinsRéalis We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people. Find out more. Additional information AtkinsRéalis cares about your privacy. AtkinsRéalis and other subsidiary or affiliated companies of AtkinsRéalis (referred to throughout as "AtkinsRéalis") are committed to protecting your privacy. Please consult our Privacy Notice on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer your Personal Data. By submitting your personal information to AtkinsRéalis, you confirm that you have read and accept our Privacy Notice. Appropriate accommodation will be provided upon request throughout the recruitment and hiring process as required by Company policy and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Successful applicants will be notified about AtkinsRéalis' accommodation policies at the time the employment offer is extended, and the information will be shared with new personnel during the onboarding process. Expected compensation for this role is between $80,000 - $100,000 annually. Base salaries are determined according to several parameters like skills, experience, and potential impact on the role. Internal and external competitiveness are also taken into account in our offers.

review_candidates.title: Completion Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Suburban Connect is a consortium of global leaders in tunnelling, comprising CPB Contractors, Ghella, and Acciona Construction. Together, we are delivering the southern section of tunnels for Suburban Rail Loop (SRL) East – 16km of twin tunnels between Cheltenham and Glen Waverley, which will be Victoria’s longest transport tunnel. This project is being delivered on behalf of the Suburban Rail Loop Authority (SRLA). About The Role The primary purpose of the Completion Coordinator is to assist the Completion Manager achieve the Project’s completion objectives by implementing and communicating Suburban Connects completion strategy. The role’s responsibilities are outlines in the “Functional Responsibilities” Tab below and cover both: Coordination of completion records to achieve successful handover; and Defect management prior to Practical Completion (PC) and during the Defects Liability Period (DLP) in the role of Defects Coordinator. Completion Coordinators will be assigned to dedicated Separable Portions (SP), however they will be required to assist with completion activities at other SP’s, depending on handover dates and workload at the time. Key Accountabilities Prior to Practical Completion Responsible for the coordination of the overall completions process on site, at each Separable Portion assigned to them. Track and report on completion activities, back to the Completion Manager. Assist Completion Manager to produce completion reporting for the various completion milestones. Liaise with SC internal teams to: Communicate the handover deliverables assigned to each discipline Ensure handover deliverables are being submitted in a timely manner and to the required standard. Develop, lead and maintain interface with SRLA and stakeholders, driving a collaborative approach to: Achieve defect acceptance and close out Review of deliverable submissions for handover to achieve CRF acceptance and close-out. Assist with defect management by: Implementing the defect management approach & procedures Scheduling completion inspections and defect walkthroughs. Responsible for verifying and coordinating the close-out of defects after rectification. Tracking and reporting on defect closeout status During Defects Liability Period Nominated by the Project Director to manage the rectification of defects identified after PC and during the DLP. Responsible for tracking and reporting on defect status during DLP. Organising defect walkthroughs with the relevant stakeholders during DLP SRL East, spanning from Cheltenham to Box Hill, is now being constructed. Tunnelling is set to commence in 2026, with trains expected to begin running by 2035. The works include 55 cross passages, two tunnel portal structures, two station box excavations, and various associated support tasks. At Suburban Connect, we are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our community. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. Our available roles span various professional areas, including construction and engineering, planning and environmental management, corporate support, administration, communications, and more. Join us in delivering one of Victoria’s most significant infrastructure projects in a safe, inclusive, and collaborative environment.

Für ein strategisch bedeutendes Transformationsvorhaben suchen wir ab Dezember 2026 eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Projektleiter:in – Aufbau Portfoliomanagement-Lösung & Business Transformation. Dich erwartet eine aussergewöhnliche Aufgabe an der Schnittstelle von Business Transformation, Portfoliomanagement, Projektsteuerung und Systemeinführung. Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle beim Aufbau einer modernen Portfoliomanagement-Lösung und prägst damit, wie komplexe Vorhaben künftig geplant, priorisiert, gesteuert und transparent geführt werden. Standort: Region Bern, mit Homeoffice-Anteil nach Absprache.   Dein Beitrag Du führst das Vorhaben von der Konzeption über den Aufbau bis zur Einführung. Dabei steuerst Du nicht nur Termine, Kosten und Lieferobjekte, sondern sorgst vor allem dafür, dass Fachlichkeit, Organisation, Technologie und strategische Zielsetzung konsequent zusammenfinden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Programmleitung zusammen, führst Teilprojektleitende und Spezialist:innen und stellst sicher, dass aus verschiedenen Konzepten, Integrationen und Anforderungen eine konsistente Gesamtlösung entsteht. In der Programmdurchführung bist Du direkt der Programmleitung unterstellt und Teil des Programmkernteams. Verantwortungsbereiche:  Führung eines komplexen Transformations- und Einführungsprojekts von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Pilotbetrieb und Rollout Verantwortung für Projektplanung, Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten, Kosten, Risiken und Lieferobjekte Sicherstellung der Konsistenz von Fach-, Detail-, System-, Integrations- und Einführungskonzepten Führung und Koordination von Teilprojektleitenden sowie Spezialist:innen aus Business Analyse, Testing, Consulting und Technologie Steuerung der Integration einer modernen Portfoliomanagement-Lösung mit SAP ERP und weiteren Umsystemen Planung und Führung des Pilotbetriebs sowie Vorbereitung der organisatorischen Einführung Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Programmleitung, PMO, Qualitäts- und Risikomanagement sowie internen und externen Leistungserbringern Anwendung klassischer, agiler und hybrider Vorgehensmodelle passend zur jeweiligen Projektsituation Erstellung und Steuerung von Managementplänen, Masterplänen, Controlling-Berichten und Entscheidungsgrundlagen   Expertenprofil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Business-, Transformations- oder Digitalisierungsprojekte Ausgeprägte Erfahrung im Projekt-, Programm- oder Portfoliomanagement Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Stakeholdermanagement, Projektsteuerung und organisationsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit Erfahrung mit Systemeinführungen und der Steuerung komplexer fachlicher und technischer Abhängigkeiten Fähigkeit, Business-Anforderungen, Governance und technologische Umsetzung wirkungsvoll zu verbinden FH-Bachelor in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Technik Gültige Zertifizierung als Certified Project Manager IPMA Level C oder höher Gültige HERMES Foundation und/oder Advanced Zertifizierung Ein MAS, EMBA oder MBA sowie Zertifikate in agilem Projektmanagement wie SAFe, Scrum Master oder Product Owner sind von grossem Vorteil. Du erhältst die seltene Gelegenheit, eine neue Portfoliomanagement-Lösung mitzugestalten, die künftig strategische Steuerung, Projekt- und Programmmanagement, Controlling, Reporting und Business Analytics auf einer zentralen Datenbasis zusammenführt. Du arbeitest an einem Vorhaben mit hoher Sichtbarkeit, grosser organisatorischer Wirkung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Entscheidungen beeinflussen nicht nur ein einzelnes Projekt, sondern die Art und Weise, wie komplexe Vorhaben künftig geführt und priorisiert werden. Für erfahrene Projektleiter:innen, die nochmals eine wirklich besondere Herausforderung übernehmen und ihre Erfahrung sichtbar in eine nachhaltige Transformation einbringen möchten, ist dies eine aussergewöhnliche Gelegenheit. Du willst nicht einfach ein Projekt erfolgreich abschliessen, sondern etwas aufbauen, das langfristig Wirkung entfaltet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung per E-Mail an info@oeschconsultingexperts.ch
